mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is "HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions": internal hosts are not exempt, so plain HTTP is not permitted for them and all connections, internal or external, must use HTTPS. Certificate verification stays enabled on all builds.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
